description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and goading it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
